A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''heir''' of the [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], was the son of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He set out to hunt [[split-tail dorsallope]] with a dozen of [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guard]] and went missing near the [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]] territory. His father, [[Count/Legends|Count]] Demici, suspected the rival House Nalju, for his son's disappearance.<ref name="FH" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] were hired to locate a missing heir by Count Demici on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. During their investigation in Nalju territory, they were captured and accused of espionage and brought to a [[Unidentified House Nalju encampment|House Nalju encampment]] led by a [[Unidentified House Nalju heir|heir]] of Count [[Unidentified House Nalju count|Nalju]]. Young Nalju claimed that he was investigating a sighting of House Demici Noble Guard and that he would gladly escort the Demici heir home if he found him, in order to avoid war between their houses. The group learned that House Nalju was not responsible for the boy's disappearance.<ref name="FH" />

In the middle of the night, the Nalju encampment was [[Raid on a House Nalju encampment|attacked]] by House Demici Noble Guardsmen. The heir to House Nalju was stunned and abducted into the forest. The group followed the kidnappers to a canyon. Once inside, they discovered the two heirs have allied to drive their houses to war. They had planned to kill their fathers during the confusion and take over their respective houses, and after a brief arms race, unite House Demici and House Nalju and dominate Serenno.<ref name="FH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
A House Demici heir was first mentioned in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH" />
